title: Warez front door, layer 2 base overlay
description: Applied BESIDE the kind's L1 schema, never instead of it: a submission is valid at the front door when it passes <kind>.schema.json AND this overlay AND the kind's own L2 file (warez/<kind>.schema.json, which already pulls in both). It only tightens properties L0 already defines and adds none, so L1's unevaluatedProperties closure is unaffected. Rules that need the signed-in account (the publisher part of id equals the account handle) are pipeline gate 4, not schema. See docs/warez/03-contracts-and-schemas.md.

id.description: Always <publisher>/<name> at the front door: the publisher by the catalog PUBLISHER_RE, the name by SKILL_NAME_RE.

tier.description: Nothing builtin or dev comes through the front door.

description.description: The card text. Required here because the card needs a brief.

license.description: An SPDX expression. Which ids are allowed is policy (warez/policy.json licenses.allow), checked by gate 8.

links.description: L0 defines links (L0-4); the front door restates that every URL is https.
